title: Investigate duplicate billing from SDK retry propagation and gateway race
creator: Ethan Morales
description: Summary: A mid-market customer reported a ~3x unexpected usage spike for a 24-hour window that resulted in an overage charge. Investigation showed duplicated metering events when SDK retries landed on a fallback proxy while the original request was still being processed. This ticket captures the investigation timeline, root cause, mitigation steps, credits issued, and follow-up engineering work to prevent recurrence.
comments: 2026-03-09 - Initial report from Support: Customer AcmeDocs noticed 3x token usage over 24h and opened a billing dispute. Billing team created escalation to ENG.
2026-03-09 - Triage call: Included Billing, Support, Runtime, API-Gateway, and Observability. Priority set to P1 due to direct customer charge and potential reputational risk.

2026-03-10 - Observability notes: Traces show matching request payloads with identical client_request_id but different internal request_ids. Two metering records were emitted within 200-600ms of each other for ~1,200 requests during spike window.

2026-03-10 - Runtime team hypothesis: Retry from SDK hit a fallback edge proxy (region failover) before the origin proxy had persisted the first metering event to the aggregator. Aggregator lacked strict dedup semantics across proxies.

2026-03-11 - Confirmed: Metering pipeline groups events by request_id when present. SDK only sets client_request_id in 60% of calls; in other flows we saw race where gateway assigned new internal IDs and both were accepted as distinct.

2026-03-11 - Hotfix deployed: Gateway now forwards client_request_id header to runtime and enforces an idempotency window (2s) where duplicate internal request_ids are suppressed. Patch rolled as runtime-1.20.1.

2026-03-12 - Aggregator change deployed: Added dedupe step keyed on client_request_id (if present) and on sha256(payload) as fallback. Backfill corrected counts for impacted customer and surrounding tenants.
2026-03-12 - Billing action: Issued a proactive credit to AcmeDocs for the overage period: $12,340. Customer accepted and ticket closed on their side.
2026-03-13 - Postmortem review: Root cause and fixes reviewed with PM, Observability, Runtime, and Billing. Action items agreed and prioritized into next two cycles.
2026-03-13 - Notes: No evidence of fraud or malicious traffic. This was an operational race combined with incomplete dedupe coverage and inconsistent SDK use of client_request_id.
2026-03-13 - Owner transition: Follow-ups assigned to Avery Chen for engineering work and Priya Patel for customer communication and billing reconciliation.
resolution: Billing overcount caused by duplicate metering across proxies due to SDK retry propagation and missing dedup keys. Fixed with gateway header forwarding + idempotency window, aggregator dedupe, and backfilled corrected usage. Customer credited.
action_items: Add mandatory SDK telemetry: make client_request_id generation enabled by default in all official SDKs (ENG-SDK-2026).
Extend aggregator dedupe window and ensure cross-proxy idempotency keys are canonicalized (PR #1245).
Add end-to-end test for retry+failover flow that asserts single metering event per client_request_id (test harness update).
Create dashboard and alert for per-customer sudden multi-hit de-dup ratios > 1.2x over 1h (observability runbook).
Document customer credit process and SLA for billing disputes in Confluence and CS runbook.
